topic: Quick take: no-code or a custom build?
caption:
No-code or a custom build? Quick take. ⚖️

No-code tools are great for testing an idea fast: simple workflows, internal tools, a first prototype.

A custom build makes sense when you need your own business logic, serious integrations, room to scale, or full ownership of your code and data.

Neither is "better". The right choice depends on what you're building and where it needs to go next. Plenty of products start in one and move to the other.

Which one did you start with? Tell us in the comments. 👇
